name: Ловля фігури (2)
description:
If a piece has little freedom of movement, it can get into trouble. A simple attack on this piece will then immediately lead to material gain.

Now that you are progressing further in the Chessity learning path, the tactical motives will become deeper. Before you can win material, you will sometimes have to make a few preparatory moves to chase an enemy piece.

What do you have to do?

Win material by trapping a piece. Sometimes a few preparatory moves are needed.

examples.text: White was very eager to capture the pawn on a7. After 1...b6! White undoubtedly regrets it.
The black queen seems to be dangerous. But after 1...g3! it suddenly appears that she has no more escape squares.

texts: The white queen has little mobility.
